```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Functions defined here
# copied from https://rdrr.io/bioc/imageHTS/man/zprime.html

zprime = function(a, b, method=c('mahalanobis', 'robust', 'fixsd', 'original')) {
    method = match.arg(method)
    
    if (method=='mahalanobis') {
        if (is.null(dim(a))) a = matrix(a, ncol=1)
        if (is.null(dim(b))) b = matrix(b, ncol=1)
        mua = apply(a, 2, mean)
        mub = apply(b, 2, mean)
        dm = try(mahalanobis(mua, mub, cov(a) + cov(b)))
        if (class(dm)=='try-error') NA
        else 1-3/sqrt(dm)
    }
    else {
        if (method=='robust') 1-3*(mad(a)+mad(b))/abs(median(a)-median(b))
        else if (method=='fixsd') 1-3*sqrt(var(a)+var(b))/abs(mean(a)-mean(b))
        else 1-3*(sd(a)+sd(b))/abs(mean(a)-mean(b))
    }
}


investigate_raw_maps <- function(to_plot, request){
    request <- eval(request)
    request <- quo_name(enquo(request))
    
    raw_map(data = to_plot[[request]], 
            well = to_plot$well, 
            plate = 96) + labs(title = request)
}
```

LOESS then Z score (pop. literature method)


```{r loessforreal}
# OK OK. LOESS THEN Z SCORE

loess_dataset <- final_plate_list

variables_of_interest <- setdiff(colnames(final_plate_list), c("plate", "well", "Row", "Column", "gene"))

rownames(loess_dataset) <- make.unique(loess_dataset$gene)

loess_models <- lapply(variables_of_interest, function(x) {
    loess(as.formula(paste0("`",x,"`", " ~ Row + Column")),
          data = loess_dataset,
          span = 1,  # Adjust?
          degree = 1)    # Linear fit recommended for spatial patterns
})

names(loess_models) <- variables_of_interest

loess_fits <- lapply(variables_of_interest, function(y) {
    loess_models[[y]]["fitted"]
}) 
names(loess_fits) <- variables_of_interest


loess_results <- lapply(variables_of_interest, function(z){
    loess_models[[z]][["y"]]-(loess_fits[[z]][["fitted"]]-median(loess_fits[[z]][["fitted"]]))
})

names(loess_results) <- variables_of_interest

df_loess_results <- data.table(do.call(bind_cols, loess_results))

df_loess_results <- bind_cols(df_loess_results, loess_dataset %>% dplyr::select(c("plate", "Row", "Column", "well", "gene")))


### Visualise the loessing if need:
# not fully corrected
# raw_map(data = final_plate_list$`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Median per Well`,
#         well = final_plate_list$well,
#         plate = 96)
# 
# 
# raw_map(data = df_loess_results[df_loess_results$plate == "P1_SIMA_V1.txt"] %>% dplyr::select(`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Median per Well`),
#         well = df_loess_results[df_loess_results$plate == "P1_SIMA_V1.txt"] %>% dplyr::select(well),
#         plate = 96)



### Z scores per plate on loess normalised data
variables_of_interest <- setdiff(colnames(df_loess_results), c("plate","well","Row","Column","gene"))

which_plate <- unique(df_loess_results$plate)

all_plate_z_scores <- data.table()

for (j in seq_along(which_plate)) {
    
    # test
    #print(which_plate[j])
    
    ### SUBSET DATA TO PLATE LEVEL FOR Z-SCORE CALCULATIONS
    temp_plate_list <- df_loess_results %>% dplyr::filter( plate == which_plate[j])
    
    ### BEGIN 2ND LOOP FOR Z SCORE CALCS
    
    
    for (i in seq_along(variables_of_interest)) {
        
        #print(variables_of_interest[i])
        
        temp_var <- variables_of_interest[i]
        
        ### First get the mean and stdev which can change per iteration
        mean_NTC_var <- mean(temp_plate_list[[temp_var]]) # mean of variable across all genes
        stdev_var <- sd(temp_plate_list[[temp_var]]) # standard deviation for var across all genes
        
        
        ### Then get the Z-score
        temp_plate_list <- temp_plate_list %>%
            mutate(
                !!paste0(temp_var,"_z_score") := ( (.data[[temp_var]] - mean_NTC_var) / stdev_var)
            ) # this madness is needed for strings to become variable names
        ### Then the Sigma Z score
        assign(paste0("`",temp_var,"sigma_z_score","`"), sd(temp_plate_list[[paste0(temp_var,"_z_score")]][str_detect(temp_plate_list$gene, "NTC")]))
        #print(eval(as.name(paste0("`",temp_var,"sigma_z_score","`")), envir= .GlobalEnv)) #debugging
        
        ### Then the effect sizes
        temp_plate_list <- temp_plate_list %>%
            mutate(
                !!paste0(temp_var,"effect_size") := .data[[paste0(temp_var,"_z_score")]] /eval(as.name(paste0("`",temp_var,"sigma_z_score","`")), envir= .GlobalEnv)
            )
        
    }
    
    ### ONCE ALL CALCULATED BIND ONTO PREVIOUS RESULTS
    all_plate_z_scores <- bind_rows(all_plate_z_scores, temp_plate_list)
    
}    



```

Find top 5 genes ranked by Z-score


```{r top5genes}


### which genes are the most extreme then?

z_scores_post_loess_only <- all_plate_z_scores %>% 
    dplyr::select(contains("z_score"), gene, plate)

which_col <- setdiff(colnames(z_scores_post_loess_only), c("gene", "plate", "Row", "Column", "well"))
top_5_genes_zscore <- data.table(Rank = c("1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", "5th", "6th", "7th"))
temp_top_genes <- data.table()
for (i in seq_along(which_col)) {
    
    temp_top_genes <- z_scores_post_loess_only %>%
        group_by(gene) %>% 
        summarise_at(vars(-c(plate)), median) %>% 
        slice_max(.data[[which_col[i]]], n = 7) %>% 
        dplyr::select(gene) %>% 
        dplyr::rename(!!which_col[i] := gene)
    
    top_5_genes_zscore <- bind_cols(top_5_genes_zscore, temp_top_genes)
}
```

ANOVA?


```{r anovas}


z_scores_post_loess_only <- all_plate_z_scores %>% 
    dplyr::select(contains("z_score"), gene, Row, Column, well, plate)

pca_plot_data <- z_scores_post_loess_only %>%  filter(gene != "Empty")


### spot count

spot_count_df <- data.frame(spot_count = pca_plot_data$cell_width_to_length_z_score,
                            gene = pca_plot_data$gene) #pca_plot_data$`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Mean per Well_z_score`

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result_sc <- aov(spot_count ~ gene, data = spot_count_df)
summary(anova_result_sc)

plot(anova_result_sc)


# Use the Dunnett's test because Tukey compares everything to everything
# meaning for our case of 70 genes +5 controls, 75C2 = 2775

library(DescTools)
sc_ctrl <- DunnettTest(x=spot_count_df$spot_count, g=spot_count_df$gene, control = "NTC3")
dunnett_summary_sc <- as.data.frame(sc_ctrl$NTC3) %>% 
    mutate(comparisons = rownames(.))

###

ds_sc <- dunnett_summary_sc %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "contrast") %>%
    #extract the tested group name (the part before or after the dash; adjust if needed)
    mutate(group = str_split_fixed(contrast, "-", 2)[,1], control = str_split_fixed(contrast, "-", 2)[,2]) %>%
    #order for plotting
    dplyr::arrange(diff) %>% mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contrast))
#add a simple significance label

ds_sc <- ds_sc %>% mutate(sig = case_when( pval < 0.05 ~ "TRUE", .default="FALSE" ))


ggplot(ds_sc, aes(x = diff, y = contrast)) + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lwr.ci, xmax = upr.ci), height = 0.25, color = "grey30") +
    geom_point(aes(color = pval < 0.05), size = 2) +
    #geom_text(aes(label = sig), hjust = -0.3, vjust = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "red")) +
    labs(x = "Difference vs NTC3 (diff)", y = "",
         color = "Significant",
         title = "Dunnett test estimates and 95% CI - Cell width to length") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))



```

```{r effectsizes}
        ntc_plot_data$gene_type == "Other genes"

# Calculate the pooled NTC median using finite values only.
ntc_values <- ntc_plot_data %>%
    filter(
        gene_type == "Contains NTC",
        is.finite(nuclei_counteffect_size)
    ) %>%
    pull(nuclei_counteffect_size)

if (length(ntc_values) == 0L) {
    stop("No finite values were found for NTC-containing genes.")
}

ntc_median <- median(ntc_values)

ggplot(
    ntc_plot_data,
    aes(
        x = Gene,
        y = nuclei_counteffect_size,
        colour = gene_type
    )
) +
    geom_hline(
        yintercept = ntc_median,
        colour = "#B31B21",
        linetype = "dashed",

        values = c(

            "Other genes" = "#1465AC"
        ),
        name = "Gene type"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)) +
    ggpubr::theme_pubr() +
    labs(
        title = "Nuclei count effect sizes",
        x = "Gene Knockdown",
        y = "Nuclei count effect size"
    )
```

```{r bigchunk}

# with the help of chatgpt


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Settings and input checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reference_pattern <- "NTC"
reference_label <- "pooled NTCs"

is_ntc <- function(x) {
    grepl(reference_pattern, as.character(x), ignore.case = TRUE)
}

metadata_cols <- c("plate", "well", "Row", "Column", "gene")
loess_dataset <- as.data.frame(final_plate_list)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(metadata_cols, names(loess_dataset))

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0L) {
    stop(
        "Missing metadata columns: ",
        paste(missing_metadata, collapse = ", ")
    )
}

if (anyNA(loess_dataset$plate) || anyNA(loess_dataset$gene)) {
    stop("plate and gene must not contain missing values.")
}

# Optional: uncomment to exclude Empty wells.
# loess_dataset <- loess_dataset %>%
#     dplyr::filter(gene != "Empty")

if (nrow(loess_dataset) == 0L) {
    stop("No wells are available for analysis.")
}

if (!is.numeric(loess_dataset$Row) ||
    !is.numeric(loess_dataset$Column)) {
    stop("Row and Column must be numeric coordinates.")
}

variables_of_interest <- setdiff(
    names(loess_dataset),
    metadata_cols
)

if (length(variables_of_interest) == 0L) {
    stop("No measurement columns were found.")
}

numeric_measurements <- vapply(
    loess_dataset[variables_of_interest],
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
)

if (!all(numeric_measurements)) {
    stop(
        "These measurement columns are not numeric: ",
        paste(
            variables_of_interest[!numeric_measurements],
            collapse = ", "
        )
    )
}

if (!any(is_ntc(loess_dataset$gene))) {
    stop("No gene names contain: ", reference_pattern)
}

which_plate <- unique(loess_dataset$plate)

plates_without_ntcs <- setdiff(
    which_plate,
    unique(loess_dataset$plate[is_ntc(loess_dataset$gene)])
)

if (length(plates_without_ntcs) > 0L) {
    warning(
        "No NTC wells on these plates: ",
        paste(plates_without_ntcs, collapse = ", "),
        ". Their Glass's delta values will be NA."
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOESS correction separately for each plate and measurement
#    Original row order is preserved.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df_loess_results <- loess_dataset

for (plate_id in which_plate) {

    plate_rows <- which(loess_dataset$plate == plate_id)
    plate_data <- loess_dataset[plate_rows, , drop = FALSE]

    for (temp_var in variables_of_interest) {

        fit_data <- data.frame(
            value = plate_data[[temp_var]],
            Row = plate_data$Row,
            Column = plate_data$Column
        )

        valid <- with(
            fit_data,
            is.finite(value) &
                is.finite(Row) &
                is.finite(Column)
        )

        corrected <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(plate_data))

        if (sum(valid) < 6L ||
            length(unique(fit_data$Row[valid])) < 2L ||
            length(unique(fit_data$Column[valid])) < 2L) {

            warning(
                "Insufficient spatial data for plate ", plate_id,
                ", measurement ", temp_var,
                "; corrected values set to NA."
            )

        } else {

            fit <- stats::loess(
                value ~ Row + Column,
                data = fit_data[valid, , drop = FALSE],
                span = 1,
                degree = 1,
                normalize = FALSE,
                na.action = stats::na.fail
            )

            fitted_values <- as.numeric(fit$fitted)

            if (any(!is.finite(fitted_values))) {
                stop(
                    "Non-finite LOESS fitted values for plate ", plate_id,
                    ", measurement ", temp_var,
                    ". Inspect the spatial fit."
                )
            }

            corrected[valid] <- fit_data$value[valid] -
                (fitted_values - stats::median(fitted_values))
        }

        df_loess_results[[temp_var]][plate_rows] <- corrected
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Whole-plate z-scores on LOESS-corrected measurements
#    Retained for PCA.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_plate_z_scores <- df_loess_results
z_score_cols <- paste0(variables_of_interest, "_z_score")

if (any(z_score_cols %in% names(df_loess_results))) {
    stop("Generated z-score names overlap existing input columns.")
}

for (i in seq_along(variables_of_interest)) {

    temp_var <- variables_of_interest[i]
    z_col <- z_score_cols[i]

    all_plate_z_scores[[z_col]] <- NA_real_

    for (plate_id in which_plate) {

        plate_rows <- which(all_plate_z_scores$plate == plate_id)
        x <- df_loess_results[[temp_var]][plate_rows]
        valid <- is.finite(x)

        z <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))

        if (sum(valid) >= 2L) {

            plate_mean <- mean(x[valid])
            plate_sd <- stats::sd(x[valid])

            if (is.finite(plate_mean) &&
                is.finite(plate_sd) &&
                plate_sd > 0) {
                z[valid] <- (x[valid] - plate_mean) / plate_sd
            }
        }

        all_plate_z_scores[[z_col]][plate_rows] <- z
    }
}

# Exclude gene and handle missing values before calling prcomp().
z_scores_post_loess_only <- all_plate_z_scores %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(z_score_cols), gene)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Glass's delta against pooled NTC wells
#    One effect per gene, plate and measurement.
#
#    delta = (gene mean - pooled NTC mean) / pooled NTC SD
#
#    Using plate z-scores gives the same delta as using the
#    LOESS-corrected measurements, when both are defined.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

z_long <- all_plate_z_scores %>%
    dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(c("plate", "gene", z_score_cols))
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = dplyr::all_of(z_score_cols),
        names_to = ".measurement",
        names_pattern = "^(.*)_z_score$",
        values_to = ".score"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
        plate,
        gene,
        variable = .measurement,
        z_score = dplyr::if_else(
            is.finite(.score),
            .score,
            NA_real_
        )
    )

# Pool all NTC wells within each plate and measurement.
# Each well has equal weight, regardless of its NTC gene name.
reference_stats <- z_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_ntc(gene)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(plate, variable) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
        n_reference = sum(!is.na(z_score)),
        reference_mean = if (n_reference > 0L) {
            mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
            NA_real_
        },
        reference_sd = if (n_reference >= 2L) {
            stats::sd(z_score, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
            NA_real_
        },
        .groups = "drop"
    )

all_plate_effect_sizes <- z_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(plate, gene, variable) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
        n_wells = sum(!is.na(z_score)),
        gene_mean = if (n_wells > 0L) {
            mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
            NA_real_
        },
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
        reference_stats,
        by = c("plate", "variable")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        glass_delta = dplyr::if_else(
            n_wells > 0L &
                !is.na(n_reference) & n_reference >= 2L &
                is.finite(gene_mean) &
                is.finite(reference_mean) &
                is.finite(reference_sd) & reference_sd > 0,
            (gene_mean - reference_mean) / reference_sd,
            NA_real_
        )
    )

if (any(!is.finite(all_plate_effect_sizes$glass_delta))) {
    warning(
        "Some effects could not be calculated. Check n_wells, ",
        "n_reference and reference_sd in all_plate_effect_sizes."
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Prepare plotting data
#    Mean effects give each valid plate equal weight.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_data <- all_plate_effect_sizes %>%
    dplyr::rename(measurement = variable) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(glass_delta)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene, measurement) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        mean_effect = mean(glass_delta)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        gene = factor(gene)
    )

colour_limit <- if (nrow(plot_data) > 0L) {
    max(abs(plot_data$mean_effect))
} else {
    1
}

if (!is.finite(colour_limit) || colour_limit == 0) {
    colour_limit <- 1
}

# Optional fixed limits:
# colour_limit <- 3

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot option 1: boxes coloured by mean effect
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (selected_measurement in variables_of_interest) {

    single_plot_data <- plot_data %>%
        dplyr::filter(measurement == selected_measurement)

    if (nrow(single_plot_data) == 0L) {
        warning(
            "No valid effects to plot for measurement: ",
            selected_measurement
        )
        next
    }

    single_effect_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
        single_plot_data,
        ggplot2::aes(
            x = gene,
            y = glass_delta,
            group = gene
        )
    ) +
        ggplot2::geom_hline(
            yintercept = 0,
            colour = "grey70",
            linetype = "dashed"
        ) +
        ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
            ggplot2::aes(fill = mean_effect),
            outlier.shape = NA
        ) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
            position = ggplot2::position_jitter(
                width = 0.15,
                height = 0,
                seed = 1
            ),
            alpha = 0.6,
            size = 1.5
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
            low = "#2166AC",
            mid = "white",
            high = "#B2182B",
            midpoint = 0,
            limits = c(-colour_limit, colour_limit),
            oob = scales::squish,
            name = "Mean effect"
        ) +
        ggplot2::coord_flip() +
        ggplot2::labs(
            title = selected_measurement,
            x = "Gene",
            y = paste("Glass's delta vs", reference_label)
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_bw() +
        ggplot2::theme(
            axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
            panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
        )

    print(single_effect_plot)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot option 2: NTCs coloured together and grouped at the top
#    Dotted line = median of NTC gene-level, plate-level effects.
#    This median is distinct from the pooled reference mean.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (selected_measurement in variables_of_interest) {

    single_plot_data <- plot_data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
            measurement == selected_measurement,
            is.finite(glass_delta)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            gene = as.character(gene),
            gene_type = dplyr::if_else(
                is_ntc(gene),
                "Contains NTC",
                "Other genes"
            )
        )

    if (nrow(single_plot_data) == 0L) {
        warning(
            "No valid effects to plot for measurement: ",
            selected_measurement
        )
        next
    }

    # Last factor levels appear at the top after coord_flip().
    gene_order <- c(
        rev(sort(unique(single_plot_data$gene[
            single_plot_data$gene_type == "Other genes"
        ]))),
        rev(sort(unique(single_plot_data$gene[
            single_plot_data$gene_type == "Contains NTC"
        ])))
    )

    single_plot_data <- single_plot_data %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            gene = factor(gene, levels = gene_order)
        )

    ntc_values <- single_plot_data$glass_delta[
        single_plot_data$gene_type == "Contains NTC"
    ]

    ntc_median <- if (length(ntc_values) > 0L) {
        median(ntc_values)
    } else {
        NA_real_
    }

    single_effect_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
        single_plot_data,
        ggplot2::aes(
            x = gene,
            y = glass_delta,
            group = gene
        )
    ) +
        ggplot2::geom_hline(
            yintercept = 0,
            colour = "grey70",
            linetype = "dashed"
        ) +
        ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
            ggplot2::aes(colour = gene_type),
            outlier.shape = NA
        ) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
            position = ggplot2::position_jitter(
                width = 0.15,
                height = 0,
                seed = 1
            ),
            alpha = 0.6,
            size = 1.5
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
            values = c(
                "Contains NTC" = "#B31B21",
                "Other genes" = "#1465AC"
            ),
            name = "Gene type"
        ) +
        ggplot2::coord_flip() +
        ggplot2::labs(
            title = selected_measurement,
            x = "Gene",
            y = paste("Glass's delta vs", reference_label)
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_bw() +
        ggplot2::theme(
            axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
            panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
        )

    if (is.finite(ntc_median)) {

        single_effect_plot <- single_effect_plot +
            ggplot2::geom_hline(
                yintercept = ntc_median,
                colour = "#B31B21",
                linetype = "dotted",
                linewidth = 0.8
            ) +
            ggplot2::labs(
                subtitle = paste(
                    "Red dotted line: NTC gene-effect median =",
                    signif(ntc_median, 3)
                )
            )

    } else {

        warning(
            "No valid NTC effects for measurement: ",
            selected_measurement,
            "; NTC median line omitted."
        )
    }

    print(single_effect_plot)
}
```

```{r pcapretty}
# with the help of chatgpt


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

controls <- c("IRS1", "PTEN", "POLA1", "PPARG","NTC3", "NTC1", "NTC2", "NTC4", "NTC5")

ellipse_level <- 0.20
point_size <- 1.2
point_alpha <- 0.5

measurement_cols <- unique(variables_of_interest)
z_cols <- paste0(measurement_cols, "_z_score")
key_cols <- c("plate", "well", "gene")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Remove empty wells from both datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# is_empty_gene <- function(x) {
#   tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
#     tolower(trimws(empty_labels))
# }

prepare_pca_data <- function(input_data, dataset_name) {

  output <- as.data.frame(input_data)

  if (!all(key_cols %in% names(output))) {
    stop(dataset_name, " is missing required metadata columns.")
  }

  output[key_cols] <- lapply(
    output[key_cols],
    function(x) trimws(as.character(x))
  )

  # empty_rows <- is_empty_gene(output$gene)
  # 
  # message(
  #   dataset_name, ": removing ", sum(empty_rows),
  #   " empty-labelled wells."
  # )

  #output <- output[!empty_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  if (anyNA(output[key_cols])) {
    stop(dataset_name, " contains missing plate, WellName or Gene values.")
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(output[key_cols])) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": plate + WellName + Gene must uniquely identify each well."
    )
  }

  output
}

raw_data <- prepare_pca_data(final_plate_list, "Raw data")

normalised_data <- prepare_pca_data(
  all_plate_z_scores,
  "Normalised data"
)

if (!all(measurement_cols %in% names(raw_data)) ||
    !all(z_cols %in% names(normalised_data))) {
  stop("Some expected measurement or z-score columns are missing.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Match wells before and after normalisation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

raw_keys <- raw_data %>%
  select(all_of(key_cols)) %>%
  mutate(raw_row = row_number())

normalised_keys <- normalised_data %>%
  select(all_of(key_cols)) %>%
  mutate(normalised_row = row_number())

matched_wells <- inner_join(
  raw_keys,
  normalised_keys,
  by = key_cols
)

if (nrow(matched_wells) == 0L) {
  stop("No matching wells were found.")
}

convert_integer64 <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "integer64")) as.numeric(x) else x
}

raw_data[measurement_cols] <- lapply(
  raw_data[measurement_cols],
  convert_integer64
)

normalised_data[z_cols] <- lapply(
  normalised_data[z_cols],
  convert_integer64
)

before_matrix <- as.matrix(
  raw_data[matched_wells$raw_row, measurement_cols, drop = FALSE]
)

after_matrix <- as.matrix(
  normalised_data[matched_wells$normalised_row, z_cols, drop = FALSE]
)

colnames(after_matrix) <- measurement_cols

if (!is.numeric(before_matrix) || !is.numeric(after_matrix)) {
  stop("All PCA measurements must be numeric.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Select common usable measurements and complete wells
# ------------------------------------------------------------

has_variation <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  length(x) >= 2L && is.finite(sd(x)) && sd(x) > 0
}

keep_columns <- apply(before_matrix, 2, has_variation) &
  apply(after_matrix, 2, has_variation)

if (any(!keep_columns)) {
  message(
    "Excluded measurements: ",
    paste(colnames(before_matrix)[!keep_columns], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

before_matrix <- before_matrix[, keep_columns, drop = FALSE]
after_matrix <- after_matrix[, keep_columns, drop = FALSE]

if (ncol(before_matrix) < 2L) {
  stop("At least two usable measurements are required.")
}

keep_rows <- rowSums(!is.finite(before_matrix)) == 0 &
  rowSums(!is.finite(after_matrix)) == 0

message(
  "Excluding ", sum(!keep_rows),
  " matched wells with missing/non-finite measurements."
)

before_matrix <- before_matrix[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
after_matrix <- after_matrix[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

pca_metadata <- matched_wells[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  select(all_of(key_cols))

if (nrow(pca_metadata) < 3L) {
  stop("Too few complete matched wells remain.")
}

# Recheck variability after removing incomplete wells.
keep_columns <- apply(before_matrix, 2, has_variation) &
  apply(after_matrix, 2, has_variation)

before_matrix <- before_matrix[, keep_columns, drop = FALSE]
after_matrix <- after_matrix[, keep_columns, drop = FALSE]

if (ncol(before_matrix) < 2L) {
  stop("Too few variable measurements remain.")
}

# stopifnot(
#   !any(is_empty_gene(pca_metadata$gene)),
#   nrow(before_matrix) == nrow(pca_metadata),
#   nrow(after_matrix) == nrow(pca_metadata)
# )
# 
# message(
#   "Final PCA inputs: ", nrow(pca_metadata), " wells, ",
#   ncol(before_matrix), " measurements, 0 empty-labelled wells."
# )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Order plates numerically and create readable labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plate_levels <- unique(as.character(pca_metadata$plate))

if (any(!grepl("^p[0-9]+", plate_levels))) {
  stop("Plate names must start with P followed by a number.")
}

plate_numbers <- as.integer(
  sub("^p([0-9]+).*", "\\1", plate_levels)
)

plate_order <- order(plate_numbers, plate_levels)
plate_levels <- plate_levels[plate_order]
plate_numbers <- plate_numbers[plate_order]

if (anyDuplicated(plate_numbers)) {
  stop("Multiple plate names have the same plate number; check plate labels.")
}

plate_labels <- paste("Plate", plate_numbers)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Fit both PCAs and extract scores
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pca_before <- prcomp(before_matrix, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_after <- prcomp(after_matrix, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

make_scores <- function(pca_object, metadata) {
  metadata %>%
    mutate(
      PC1 = pca_object$x[, 1],
      PC2 = pca_object$x[, 2]
    )
}

before_scores <- make_scores(pca_before, pca_metadata)
after_scores <- make_scores(pca_after, pca_metadata)

axis_labels <- function(pca_object) {

  variance_percent <- 100 * pca_object$sdev^2 /
    sum(pca_object$sdev^2)

  list(
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", variance_percent[1]),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", variance_percent[2])
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Shared axis limits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

padded_range <- function(x) {

  limits <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  padding <- diff(limits) * 0.05

  if (padding == 0) {
    padding <- 1
  }

  limits + c(-padding, padding)
}

shared_x_limits <- padded_range(
  c(before_scores$PC1, after_scores$PC1)
)

shared_y_limits <- padded_range(
  c(before_scores$PC2, after_scores$PC2)
)

# Only retain groups suitable for fitting a 2D ellipse.
get_ellipse_data <- function(scores, group_column) {

  scores %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_column))) %>%
    filter(
      n() >= 4L &&
        qr(cbind(PC1 - mean(PC1), PC2 - mean(PC2)))$rank == 2L
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Controls in colour, with control ellipses
#    PCA is fitted to all retained genes; only controls highlighted.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_control_pca_plot <- function(scores, pca_object, plot_title) {

  axes <- axis_labels(pca_object)

  control_scores <- scores %>%
    filter(gene %in% controls)

  control_ellipse_scores <- get_ellipse_data(
    control_scores,
    "gene"
  )

  control_centres <- control_scores %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(
      PC1 = mean(PC1),
      PC2 = mean(PC2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
    geom_point(
      data = filter(scores, !(gene %in% controls)),
      colour = "grey70",
      alpha = point_alpha,
      size = point_size
    ) +
    stat_ellipse(
      data = control_ellipse_scores,
      aes(colour = gene, group = gene),
      type = "norm",
      level = ellipse_level,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = control_scores,
      aes(colour = gene),
      alpha = point_alpha,
      size = point_size
    ) +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = control_centres,
      aes(label = gene, colour = gene),
      fill = "white",
      seed = 1,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_colour_hue(
      limits = controls,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Control"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Empty wells excluded; ",
        round(ellipse_level * 100),
        "% control ellipses"
      ),
      x = axes$x,
      y = axes$y
    ) +
    coord_equal(
      xlim = shared_x_limits,
      ylim = shared_y_limits,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)
      )
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plates in colour, with plate ellipses
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_plate_pca_plot <- function(scores, pca_object, plot_title) {

  axes <- axis_labels(pca_object)

  scores <- scores %>%
    mutate(plate = factor(plate, levels = plate_levels))

  plate_ellipse_scores <- get_ellipse_data(scores, "plate")

  ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = plate)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      data = plate_ellipse_scores,
      aes(group = plate),
      type = "norm",
      level = ellipse_level,
      linewidth = 0.7,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      alpha = point_alpha,
      size = point_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_hue(
      limits = plate_levels,
      breaks = plate_levels,
      labels = plate_labels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Plate"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Empty wells excluded; ",
        round(ellipse_level * 100),
        "% plate ellipses"
      ),
      x = axes$x,
      y = axes$y
    ) +
    coord_equal(
      xlim = shared_x_limits,
      ylim = shared_y_limits,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)
      )
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Rebuild and display all four plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pca_plot_before <- make_control_pca_plot(
  before_scores, pca_before,
  "Before plate normalisation — controls highlighted"
)

pca_plot_after <- make_control_pca_plot(
  after_scores, pca_after,
  "After plate normalisation — controls highlighted"
)

pca_plate_before <- make_plate_pca_plot(
  before_scores, pca_before,
  "Before plate normalisation — coloured by plate"
)

pca_plate_after <- make_plate_pca_plot(
  after_scores, pca_after,
  "After plate normalisation — coloured by plate"
)

print(pca_plot_before)
print(pca_plot_after)
print(pca_plate_before)
print(pca_plate_after)


### also genes

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Additional PCA plots showing all retained genes
# Uses existing PCA fits, scores, settings and helper functions.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Keep gene colours consistent between before and after plots.
all_gene_levels <- sort(unique(c(
    as.character(before_scores$gene),
    as.character(after_scores$gene)
)))

all_gene_levels <- all_gene_levels[!is.na(all_gene_levels)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# All genes in colour, with gene ellipses and centre labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_all_gene_pca_plot <- function(
    scores,
    pca_object,
    plot_title,
    label_genes = TRUE
) {

    axes <- axis_labels(pca_object)

    scores <- scores %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            gene = factor(
                as.character(gene),
                levels = all_gene_levels
            )
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
            !is.na(gene),
            is.finite(PC1),
            is.finite(PC2)
        )

    gene_ellipse_scores <- get_ellipse_data(scores, "gene")

    gene_centres <- scores %>%
        dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
            PC1 = mean(PC1),
            PC2 = mean(PC2),
            .groups = "drop"
        )

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
        scores,
        ggplot2::aes(PC1, PC2, colour = gene)
    ) +
        ggplot2::stat_ellipse(
            data = gene_ellipse_scores,
            ggplot2::aes(group = gene),
            type = "norm",
            level = ellipse_level,
            linewidth = 0.7,
            show.legend = FALSE
        ) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
            alpha = point_alpha,
            size = point_size
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_colour_hue(
            limits = all_gene_levels,
            breaks = all_gene_levels,
            drop = FALSE,
            name = "Gene"
        ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
            title = plot_title,
            subtitle = paste0(
                "Empty wells excluded; ",
                round(ellipse_level * 100),
                "% gene ellipses where estimable"
            ),
            x = axes$x,
            y = axes$y
        ) +
        ggplot2::coord_equal(
            xlim = shared_x_limits,
            ylim = shared_y_limits,
            expand = FALSE
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        ggplot2::theme(
            panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            legend.position = "right"
        ) +
        ggplot2::guides(
            colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(
                override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)
            )
        )

    if (label_genes) {
        p <- p +
            ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
                data = gene_centres,
                ggplot2::aes(label = gene),
                fill = "white",
                seed = 1,
                max.overlaps = Inf,
                show.legend = FALSE
            )
    }

    return(p)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build additional plots
# The existing plate function already plots every supplied gene.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pca_all_genes_before <- make_all_gene_pca_plot(
    before_scores,
    pca_before,
    "Before plate normalisation — coloured by gene"
)

pca_all_genes_after <- make_all_gene_pca_plot(
    after_scores,
    pca_after,
    "After plate normalisation — coloured by gene"
)

pca_all_plates_before <- make_plate_pca_plot(
    before_scores,
    pca_before,
    "Before plate normalisation — all genes, coloured by plate"
)

pca_all_plates_after <- make_plate_pca_plot(
    after_scores,
    pca_after,
    "After plate normalisation — all genes, coloured by plate"
)

print(pca_all_genes_before)
print(pca_all_genes_after)
print(pca_all_plates_before)
print(pca_all_plates_after)

# If gene labels become too crowded, use label_genes = FALSE
# in either make_all_gene_pca_plot() call.

```
